defects.description: The glossary term 'Finding' must be translated as 'Вывод', but 'результаты' was used instead.
The term 'safe value' is incorrectly translated as 'безопасного замечания' (safe remark/note) instead of 'безопасного значения'.
The term 'defaults' (referring to default values) is incorrectly translated as 'замечания по умолчанию' (default remarks/notes).
